boundary: No sampling CI, causal mechanism or independent geographic replication. One Portal landscape. Same-source earlier work means heldout years are not virgin source data. No seed fate or seed availability measured in this analysis. Changing plot membership across years is a limitation; same four sessions within year are matched. Invalid captures excluded not corrected; source-defined granivore label is not measured seed use.
design: Portal source-defined granivorous census-target rodents, control plots, 1996-2019 training, 2020-2025 heldout calendar years. Same plots with exactly one sampled QC 48/49-trap positive-period session in each of May, June, August, September; each phase counts unique tagged individuals per session, weighted 49/effort; repeat capture in different months is a separate animal-session. No annual population estimates. At least 3 matched control plots, 20 valid target animal-sessions per phase, <=10% unresolved target capture rows. Fixed seasonal additive composition shift, compare with persistence and mean historical late composition; >=8 train years and >=4 test years. Mean equal-year TV gain and majority-year improvement. Previously used source, retrospective holdout, one desert landscape, no confirmatory evidence.
